T029 uses this to correlate with WALS features. However, the spec (US-3) and plan imply the WALS validation is an *external* validation of the *observed shift*. The dependency on T013 is correct for the 'observed' value, but T029 also requires the *null distribution* or the *statistical test results* (p-value) from T028 to contextualize the correlation (e.g., is the correlation significant?). While T029 might just output a c [... full chunk preserved on disk; desummarize() to retrieve.]
